summary: Crea-ture Studios and Nacon's realistic skateboarding sim, built around analog-stick board control, open-ended street skating, and a grounded VHS-style presentation.

entries.title: Session: Skate Sim

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Session: Skate Sim fully released for Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S in 2022, with a Nintendo Switch port in 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the realistic skateboarding sim.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives and Switch only for portable play.
